item.title: Defining 'temporary' in temporary certificates of occupancy
item.description: Temporary is a subjective word, but Longboat Key town commissioners got some clarification on what exactly it means when discussing certificates of occupancy on Longboat Key.Town Attorney Maggie Mooney provided commissioners a memo detailing the town’s rules and regulations for temporary certificates of occupancy, or TCOs, at a workshop meeting. item.title: Longboat Key water main break cuts north-end service
item.description: Water service on the north end of Longboat Key will be interrupted until evening as town workers repair a pipe break near Broadway Street and Gulf of Mexico Drive.The town said customers on the west side of GMD in the half-mile from Broadway Street to Reclinata Drive are affected.A contractor broke the water main, the town said.For questions or further assistance, the town asks that customers contact Public Works at 941-316-1988.
